why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 35's east margin prints 'AVE. I. OR SEALY' beside the adjoining-sheet numeral '36'; sheet 36's west margin prints 'AVE. I. OR SEALY' beside the adjoining numeral '35'. The next corridor on each side is named too - 'AVE. H. OR BALL' on sheet 35, 'AVE. J. OR BROADWAY' (with '150 ft wide') on sheet 36 - so Ave I is the only shared one. The 16th/17th St hundred-block steps across it: sheet 35 prints the 800 runs (801 803 805 807 809 811 813 815 817 819 821 823 and 802 804 806 808 810 812 814 816 818 820 822 824) between Ave H and Ave I; sheet 36 prints the 900 runs (901 903 ... 923 / 902 904 ... 924) between Ave I and Ave J, and the 1000 runs (1001 1003 1005 1007 1009 / 1002 1004 1006 1008 1010) east of Broadway. Avenue frontage numbers 1601-1629 / 1602-1630 (16th-17th) appear on the Ave I face of both sheets. Block numerals 256 (sheet 35) and 196 (sheet 36). Geometry: sheet 35's Ave I west block face is at native x 3050, sheet 36's east face at native x 208; the sheets' own scale gives 80 ft numbered streets = 246 native px (3.07 px/ft) and a 70 ft avenue = 211 native px (Ave H measured 2051-2262 on sheet 35), so centres sit 105 px inside each face. The 'AVE. I. OR SEALY' lettering on sheet 35 is centred at native x ~3162, confirming 3155. Detection candidates (2768 on 35, 836 on 36) fell in block interiors.
